services.name: Modern Cabins
services.desc: East Zion Resort's brand new Modern Zion Cabins are as unique as their location, highly sought after, and one-of-a-kind. Positioned at the pinnacle of the resort, some cabins not only provide unparalleled views but also ensure an extraordinary night's sleep beneath the stars, courtesy of their dedicated stargazing windows. Meanwhile, others offer roll-up doors, inviting occupants to immerse themselves in the ambiance of sleeping outdoors while still enjoying the comfort of indoor accommodations. services.name: Mirror House Rentals
services.desc: Before the resort was constructed, the stunning site, now adorned with tiny homes, yurts, treehouses, and more, was once the pristine surroundings of the Zion Cliffs Cabin. This historic cabin has been lovingly renovated to preserve its timeless beauty while seamlessly integrating modern comforts. Tucked away in a private canyon within East Zion Resort, the cabin is surrounded by towering red rock cliffs and the quiet wilderness. As you relax on your porch you'll enjoy the solitude of nature unlike anywhere else in the resort. It truly is the ultimate private getaway accompanied by the luxuries of a resort. services.name: Rock Climbing
services.desc: Embark on the ultimate rock climbing experience at East Zion Resort with our two incredible via ferrata climbs. Scale the rugged cliffs of Zion National Park on-site at the resort. Each climb offers both thrilling challenges and stunning views upon reaching the top. Not sure what a via ferrata climb is? Via Ferrata, Italian for "iron path," is a climbing experience that combines rock climbing with elements of a guided adventure. Participants traverse vertical rock faces using a system of fixed cables, ladders, and metal rungs, providing a safe yet thrilling way to access East Zion Resort's elevated landscapes.
